summary: DataMeds AI filed an 8-K disclosing a September 11, 2026 settlement with Brian Norton, Nomad Capital and Strategix resolving litigation in Florida state court and Delaware Chancery over a May 11, 2023 Membership Interest Purchase Agreement. The company paid $450,000: $350,000 to repurchase and extinguish 364,099 shares and $100,000 to settle all released claims, extinguishing roughly $19 million in balance-sheet liability. Separately, on October 13, 2026, it licensed a care management platform from REBOOT Health AI, Inc. for 666,667 shares. No advisor or premium disclosed; equity now exceeds $2,500,000, aiding Nasdaq listing compliance. Watch dilution and continued listing risk.
